name: Ray
summary: Vaccinated and microchipped. Neuter coming soon.
story: We found Ray on the street when he was a tiny kitten. We took him in, treated him, vaccinated and microchipped him, and he has grown into the sweetest, friendliest boy. It is hard to believe a cat like him was ever left on the street. Ray is soon flying to the UK, where a friend of ours has chosen to adopt him and give him his forever home.
